items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: I just went until I left Buddy. Well, I stayed with Buddy a long time... Buddy asked me would I join these bands, so I told him, yeah, I joined these bands

ctx.x: And he showed me a whole lot, and from that on, well, I just went until I left Buddy. Well, I stayed with Buddy a long time.
How did you meet him? Can you remember?
